fields.description: Skyvue Spectra is a residential tower within Sobha Hartland II, offering one- to three-bedroom apartments. Its triangular plan and stepped façade produce different outlooks and balcony arrangements across the building. The project’s own apartment drawings are distinct from neighbouring Skyvue releases and are kept separate in this record.

overview: One-bedroom Type A is a compact suite with a balcony, while the three-bedroom Type A has a different family layout. The branded pack lists unit orientations rather than promising one view for all apartments. Adjacent Skyvue Stellar and Solair plans are not substituted.
research.locationNote: Sobha Hartland II, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 2,520,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder gives 20% launch deposit, 40% construction and 40% handover. The official page did not provide a current payment document; this plan is a portal reference and must be checked for the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: Developer catalogue: March 2029. The FY 2025 developer snapshot also lists 2029, while Property Finder says August 2027. The newer official guide is retained as an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery.
